issues.description: The solution implementation of Developer.init includes an extra parameter (age) that is not present in the problem specification or the template. The template and the problem expect an initializer with two parameters (name: String, monthsOfSwiftExperience: Int?), but the solution's initializer signature is init(name: String, monthsOfSwiftExperience: Int?, age: Int). Additionally, the solution's Client.swift instantiates Developer with only two arguments, which is inconsistent with the solution's initializer signature. This constructor parameter mismatch creates a structural conflict that would confuse students and prevents straightforward comparison between template, problem statement, and solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the solution's Developer initializer match the problem/template by removing the extra age parameter. Change init(name: String, monthsOfSwiftExperience: Int?, age: Int) to init(name: String, monthsOfSwiftExperience: Int?) and keep the initializer body that prints swiftExperienceDescription(). Alternatively, if an age parameter is intentionally required, update the problem statement and all template/client usages to include and document the age parameter. Ensure Client.swift instantiates Developer with the matching parameter list.

issues.description: The Developer initializer signature is inconsistent across artifacts. The problem statement and the template expect Developer to be initialized with two parameters (name: String, monthsOfSwiftExperience: Int?). However, the solution implementation adds an extra parameter named age to the Developer initializer (init(name: String, monthsOfSwiftExperience: Int?, age: Int)). This creates an API mismatch and cognitive confusion for students trying to map the required initializer from the problem to the provided solution. It also makes the solution internally inconsistent with its Client usage (Client calls the two-parameter initializer), which can mislead learners about the intended Developer API.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the Solution Developer initializer match the Problem and Template by removing the extra age parameter. Change the solution initializer to init(name: String, monthsOfSwiftExperience: Int?) and update its body accordingly (e.g., print(self.swiftExperienceDescription())). Ensure Client usage and solution code compile with the same two-parameter initializer.
